headline: Last session: Sensex plunged 1,484 points in broad-based sell-off; markets closed today for Guru Nanak Jayanti

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: Broad-based sell-off hit Dalal Street hard during the previous trading session on November 23.
Metal and banking sector stocks were among the worst hit in Monday's market crash.
Investors lost over ₹6 lakh crore in market wealth as Sensex crashed from day's high.
Weak market sentiment and global cues led to heavy selling pressure across sectors.
whatHappening: Indian stock markets are closed today, November 24, 2026, for Guru Nanak Jayanti.
In the last trading session, Sensex closed down 1,484 points and Nifty slipped below the 25,400 mark.
IT sector stocks outshone other sectors during the sharp market downturn on Monday.
Google denied reports and rumors regarding large-scale layoffs in its India operations.
summary: Indian equity markets are closed today, November 24, on account of Guru Nanak Jayanti. In the previous trading session on November 23, domestic markets suffered a severe crash as the Sensex plunged 1,484 points and Nifty broke below 25,400, wiping out over ₹6 lakh crore of investor wealth. Trading activity on Indian exchanges will resume on Wednesday, November 25.
